title: Repair a count
prompt: Return the number of nodes in the list that starts at head. An empty list is null and has 0 nodes. The supplied listOf builds a list from an array.
hints: Trace the starter on a list of one node. How many times does its loop body run?
The loop should run once for every node, including the last one.
Loop while node !== null, and move to node.next inside the loop.
checkLabels: A list of three nodes has 3.
A list of one node has 1.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Counts the links between nodes, which is one fewer than the nodes.
Assumes there is always a first node.

feedback: Count how many times the loop body runs for a list of one node, and for an empty list.
